item_short_desc: Rothco’s Bungee Shock Cords are durable, elasticized cords designed to securely hold down your gear in a variety of situations. Whether you're preparing for a camping trip, setting up a temporary shelter, or securing items to your rucksack, these versatile bungee cords are the perfect solution. Each pack comes with 4 bungee cords, constructed to stretch while maintaining strength, ensuring your gear stays in place. The black steel hooks at each end are resilient and designed to attach easily to various items.
description: Rothco’s Bungee Shock Cords are durable, elasticized cords designed to securely hold down your gear in a variety of situations. Whether you're preparing for a camping trip, setting up a temporary shelter, or securing items to your rucksack, these versatile bungee cords are the perfect solution. Each pack comes with 4 bungee cords, constructed to stretch while maintaining strength, ensuring your gear stays in place. The black steel hooks at each end are resilient and designed to attach easily to various items, providing flexibility and ease of use. Available in multiple lengths (24, 30, and 36 inches), these shock cords are a great addition to any rucksack, car, or emergency bag. Compact and lightweight, Rothco’s Bungee Shock Cords are essential for organizing and securing your supplies efficiently.
